author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.88 shipped: A life-safety alert keeps the notification slot
summary: A life-safety alert keeps the notification slot
why: Perimeter CRITICALs (~23/day) overwrite NM's single slot; a concurrent smoke alert would drop from a 30 s to a 300 s repeat and lose its ack. Reviews found the restart path broke the same guarantee three ways; all fixed with drilled tests.
implications: Shipped NM-MULTI-ALERT-TRACKING-1 at v5.103.88; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.88.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: first post-deploy NM ack: all notification_log rows of that alert (same coordinator/hazard/location) acknowledged=1; no NM errors after restart

refs.release_notes: An unacknowledged smoke/CO/leak alert keeps NM's repeat cadence and ack target when a perimeter/energy CRITICAL arrives; ack clears all of an alert's channel rows; restart recovery prefers a fresh life-safety alert.
